title: Uniqueness from local cycle lifts
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], T and J integer cochain complexes of O_X-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], n an integer, and e,e' morphisms from H^n(Hom(T,J)) to internal Hom(H^(-n)(T),H^0(J)). Suppose both satisfy the cycle formula [new-b2-homology-evaluation-definitions]. Suppose also that on every open U, for every Hom cocycle φ and T-cycle z, the projected evaluation of their inclusions at the identity slice object admits a lift to J.cycles 0(U). Then e=e'.

source.place: Internal Hom as morphisms after restriction; uniqueness on local homology representatives, implemented by categorical epimorphism cancellation.

proof.text: Cancel the epimorphism P.homologyπ n, with P=Hom(T,J), and fix a cycle section φ over U. Regard the two internal-Hom sections as morphisms on the site over U. The overFunctor preserves finite colimits and therefore preserves the epimorphism T.homologyπ (-n). Cancel this restricted epimorphism.

At a slice object V -> U and a T-cycle z on V, restrict φ to V. The assumed lift b makes both cycle formulas equal the homology class of b. Naturality of the homology projection and of e and e' identifies those identity-slice evaluations with the components on V -> U. Extensionality for module morphisms gives the required equality.
